control_method: git archive of the rawlsing_next subtree at the pre-hardening commit, imported instead of the review target; no clone, no worktree

metadata_only_non_route_with_outer_max0.message: ROUTE_PASS_LIMIT_REACHED: full_route_passes maximum of 0 already reached (0 completed); no second source operation was performed

A_route_pass_applicability.defect: route-pass applicability is inferred from the operation rather than bound by the caller; an outer MAX 0 therefore means 'no source operation' and blocks admitted metadata work

B_retry_zero_second_attempt.defect: with SourceAccessBudget.retries = 0, a second attempt after a failed first attempt still reaches real source work (metadata_reads 1 -> 2); the retry ceiling is never consulted and there is no attempts/retries/completions separation at all

lower_layer_postcondition_failure.second_message: ROUTE_PASS_LIMIT_REACHED: full_route_passes maximum of 1 already reached (1 completed); no second source operation was performed

C_completion_before_postconditions.defect: the completed counter is incremented before the lower-layer constraints and before the outer EXACT rule, so a failed attempt still leaves a counted pass behind. With an unbounded-within-maximum outer EXACT, the phantom completion is even admitted into the outer account: attempt 2 reports observed 2 although only one attempt satisfied everything

D_discarded_dependency_injection.defect: BoundSourceExecution accepts pyreadstat_module and then passes None to the session, so a supplied dependency is silently discarded
